findings.evidence: grep hits: Mathlib/Algebra/Category/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:72 defines `CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom` and :94 has `hom_ext`; Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Hom.lean:345 defines `unitBialgHom`, :350 defines `counitBialgHom`, :354 proves `counitBialgHom_apply`; PR wrappers are at Trivial.lean:54, :68, :75, :81, :87, :92, :97.
findings.fix: Remove these declarations; use `_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.of R R`, `_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (_root_.Bialgebra.unitBialgHom R H)`, `_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (_root_.Bialgebra.counitBialgHom R H)`, and `Bialgebra.counitBialgHom_apply` directly.
findings.issue: `CommHopfAlgCat.trivial`, `unit`, `counit`, and their unwrap/apply lemmas duplicate existing Mathlib API rather than adding a new construction.

findings.evidence: grep hits: Trivial.lean:132 defines `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv`, :143/:149/:197/:204 prove the four formulas; FiniteTypeTrivial.lean:123, :129, :135, :142, :150 define wrappers whose bodies are exactly those existing declarations.
findings.fix: Do not add a parallel finite-type points API; use `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv`, `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv_apply`, `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply`, and the existing mapValue lemmas directly at the defeq type.
findings.issue: `trivialPointsMulEquiv` and its apply/naturality lemmas are just the existing `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv` API specialized through `trivial R`.

summary: The PR introduces public trivial/unit/counit APIs that are direct wrappers around existing Mathlib constructors and bialgebra maps. The finite-type file also re-exports the existing trivial points equivalence under a defeq specialization instead of reusing it directly.
